result.stdout:
Usage: skillserver publish-all <path> [options]

Batch-publish all skills found in subdirectories of <path>.
Each subdirectory must contain a SKILL.md with name and version in frontmatter.

Arguments:
  <path>                Parent directory containing skill subdirectories

Options:
  --force, -f           Delete existing versions before re-publishing
  --dry-run             Show what would be published without uploading
  --verbose, -v         Show detailed upload progress
